messages:
sanjay.pm: quick sync — we're landing the packaging/pricing change into main tomorrow. need a short status on metering, billing, quota enforcement, and any contract blockers. specifically: can billing ingest the updated usage schema? any contract clauses that block ramping quotas? @anika-engineering @josh-billing @michelle-contracts :eyes:

anika-engineering: on metering side: collector + exporter PRs are merged. default schema v2 will emit `unit_type` and `plan_id`. rolling out to canary now. no data loss expected. one caveat: legacy clients still emit `plan` string; we're transforming that in the collector.

josh-billing: billing side: ingestion service accepts schema v2 but need to update the ratecard mapper. I have a small migration branch that maps `plan_id` -> internal sku.ETA for deploy: 6 hours after canary metrics look good. I'll need a deploy window for db writes (hour).

michelle-contracts: contracts check: two enterprise customers have bespoke quota language that references "hard limit per API key" and require 30 days notice for limit changes. If we're changing default quotas for all accounts we need opt-in for those customers or a legal amendment. I flagged the two accounts in 3rd-party tracker (GH-231).

anika-engineering: noted. for those enterprise accounts we can keep their quota_tier pinned to legacy plan_id until Contracts signs the amendment. also adding a runtime guard: `if customer.override_quota then keep legacy` — low-effort.

kevin-sre: infra note: autoscaler uses historical token-per-min metrics; after schema switch we'll need to ensure the metrics exporter keeps the same metric names or update the autoscaler config. currently it reads `tokens/min` from prometheus. Recommend aliasing v2 metric to the same name for 72 hours.

devex-jen: docs/SDKs: SDKs already have PRs to surface `plan_id` in client wrappers. I'll cut a patch release after main merge. Also adding a short migration guide: snippet below.

devex-jen: ```python
# migration: map old plan string -> new plan_id
if resp.get('plan') and not resp.get('plan_id'):
    resp['plan_id'] = legacy_map[resp['plan']]
```

josh-billing: quick question: when we say "ramp quotas" do we mean default quota increase for free tier, or increasing dedicated pool limits? Need clarity so billing doesn't change pricing buckets accidentally.

sanjay.pm: default quota for self-serve free tier only. dedicated pools unaffected. if contracts flagged customers, they stay on legacy. aim is to increase free default tokens/month from 100k -> 250k.

michelle-contracts: got it. I'll draft two amendment templates: opt-in and auto-exempt notice. target legal review EOD.

anika-engineering: implementation tasks checklist (short):
- keep legacy plan_id for flagged accounts (done via override flag)
- alias metrics v2 -> `tokens/min` (kevin to coordinate)
- enable collector transform for legacy `plan` strings (merged)
- runtime guard + feature flag (on by default, kill switch)

kevin-sre: will add aliasing and a 72h retention step. scheduling change window at 02:00 UTC to minimize impact.

josh-billing: billing acceptance test plan: ingest canary -> verify mapped sku counts match old pipeline within 0.1% for 1 hour -> switch canary -> run DB write migration during low traffic window. I'll post the test script link shortly. :thumbsup:

quota-bot: automated message: flagged accounts for contract exceptions: acct_4923, acct_8110 (tracked GH-231).

sanjay.pm: thanks everyone. owners: anika (implementation), josh (billing roll), michelle (contracts), kevin (infra change), jen (SDK/docs). If you hit blockers, call out in this thread. I'll run a follow-up at +6h.

anika-engineering: ack. I'll post canary metrics once collector has 10k events.

josh-billing: ack, prepping migration branch. linking tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/tests/pull/45

michelle-contracts: drafting amendments now. ping me for account list if you want to exclude more than the two flagged.

kevin-sre: scheduling alias rollout at 02:00 UTC. I'll add alerting to rollback if `tokens/min` drops > 20%.

devex-jen: patch release ready, will cut once main merges. adding migration note to changelog.

sanjay.pm: perfect. follow-up summary: owners + deploy windows noted. leaving this open until final merge. :rocket:
